title: Piano Path
subtitle: From intermediate to ABRSM Grade 7, pop and classical; a check-in turns what you already play into quick reviews.
benchmark: ABRSM piano Grade 7, Pianote Method level 9

levels.title: Check-in
levels.goal: Find what's already solid. You skip nothing: a passed check turns its steps into reviews. Pass each review in Check on two different days.
levels.adds: Scales: check at Grade 3 and Grade 4. Pop: check a chord chart. Reading: check Level 3.

steps.title: Scales at Grade 3 speed
steps.setup: Scales: C, G, D and F major, then A, D and E harmonic minor. Hands together, two octaves, up and down, at Grade 3 (crotchet 80, two notes a click).
steps.done: 6 of the 7 keys clean within two runs.

steps.title: Scales at Grade 4 speed
steps.setup: The same keys at Grade 4 (crotchet 100), adding Bb and Eb major, B and C minor.
steps.done: 6 of 8 keys clean.

steps.title: Arpeggios
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio: C, G, F, A minor and D minor. Hands together, two octaves, at Grade 3.
steps.done: 4 of 5 clean.

steps.title: Reading
steps.setup: Reading, sight-reading Level 3 as a climb: treble, then bass.
steps.done: 80% at Level 3 in both clefs.

steps.title: Cadences
steps.setup: Voicings, cadences I IV I V7 I, in 4 keys.
steps.done: 20 chords at 85% or better.

steps.title: Chord chart
steps.setup: Jam: play I-V-vi-IV in C at 80 BPM as a self-check. RH triads in closest position, LH root. Jam runs don't count yet, so this step is scored on Voicings, closest chords.
steps.done: Two choruses without a stop or a wrong chord.

steps.title: Piece test
steps.setup: Song practice, Performance. Give each piece one week: Minuet in G minor (Grade 2), Clementi Op. 36 No. 1 first movement (Grade 3), Burgmüller Ballade Op. 100 No. 15 (Grade 4). The notation is in the level 1 and level 3 song lists.
steps.done: 90% at 100% tempo. A passed piece counts in its song list. The path still starts at level 1.

levels.test: Every level stays in the path. A step marked review needs one clean Check run on two different days, without warming up first. A review you fail turns back into a normal step.

levels.title: Chords from a chart
levels.goal: Play any I-V-vi-IV song from a chord chart, with a LH bass and RH triads. Play Grade 3 scales and arpeggios in 13 keys. Read Level 3 in both clefs.
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 3 in 13 keys. Pop: block chords, LH root-fifth-octave. Reading: Level 3 both clefs.

steps.title: Major scales at Grade 3
steps.setup: Scales: C, G, D, A, F, Bb and Eb major. Hands together, two octaves, up and down, at Grade 3.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Minor scales at Grade 3
steps.setup: Scales: A, E, D, G, B and C minor, harmonic and melodic, same setup. Scored on harmonic minor. Open melodic from the link.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.
steps.feeds: Minuet in G minor, Old French Song

steps.title: Arpeggios at Grade 3
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio: the 13 keys from steps 1 and 2, at Grade 3 (crotchet 72). Pick each key in the drill.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Contrary motion and chromatic
steps.setup: Two hands, contrary-motion scale in C. For E major and the chromatic scale from D, use Scales (Hands apart: Contrary motion).
steps.done: 3 clean runs at crotchet 80.

steps.title: Triads through their inversions, 12 keys
steps.setup: Scales, blocked chords, major then minor, each tonic, RH then LH, at 60 BPM.
steps.done: All 12 keys at 90% or better.
steps.feeds: every pop song on the shelf

steps.title: Closest-position chords from a chart
steps.setup: Voicings, closest chords, in C, G, D and F. The drill plays I IV V I. I-V-vi-IV and the top-voice limit aren't in it yet.
steps.done: 48 chords at 90%, top voice moving 4 semitones or less per change.

steps.title: Patterns 1 and 2: block chords with a LH root
steps.setup: Phrases: I vi IV V, then Jam, pop-axis, at 80 BPM. The other keys aren't in a drill yet.
steps.done: Two clean choruses in C, G and F at 80 BPM.

steps.title: Pattern 3: LH root-fifth-octave
steps.setup: Accompaniment, pattern 3 (root, fifth, octave) under I-V-vi-IV, in C, then G.
steps.done: Two clean choruses in C and G at 72 BPM.

steps.title: Sight-reading, Level 3, both clefs
steps.setup: Reading, sight-reading Level 3 as a climb: treble, then bass.
steps.done: 80% at Level 3 in each clef, on three days.

steps.title: Off-beat rhythm
steps.setup: Rhythm, groove dictation: kicks off the beat.
steps.done: 5 runs at 80% or better.

steps.title: Two songs from the list
steps.setup: Song practice: import the song, learn it in Wait mode, loop the trouble spots, then play it in Performance.
steps.done: Pass 2 songs: 90% at 100% tempo in Performance, on two days.

shelf.teaches: I-V-vi-IV from a chart, LH root
shelf.detail: C, 72 BPM, block chords, octave bass

shelf.title: Imagine
shelf.teaches: RH syncopated eighths, C to Cmaj7 to F

shelf.title: Perfect
shelf.detail: Ab (easy versions in C or G), 63 BPM, broken LH

shelf.teaches: Repeated-note RH over held LH, crescendo

shelf.teaches: Classical scale runs and broken chords, sonatina form

shelf.teaches: Staccato melody in LH and RH, 6/8

levels.test: Play two songs from this level's list, one of them classical, in Performance: 90% at 100% tempo. Play the Grade 3 scale and arpeggio in 4 keys picked for you, each clean on the first run. Play the I-V-vi-IV chart with pattern 3 in a key picked for you: two clean choruses.

levels.title: Broken chords, ballads and the pedal
levels.goal: Get the ballad sound: LH broken chords, legato pedal and a singing melody over the accompaniment. Reach Grade 4 speed in 12 keys. Start reading the grand staff.
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 4 in 12 keys. Pop: ballad LH arpeggio, RH broken triads, legato pedal. Reading: grand staff at Grade 3.

steps.title: Major scales at Grade 4
steps.setup: Scales: C, G, D, A, E, F, Bb and Eb major. Hands together, two octaves, at Grade 4 (crotchet 100).
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Minor scales at Grade 4
steps.setup: Scales: A, E, B, D, G and C minor, harmonic and melodic, at Grade 4. Scored on harmonic minor. Open melodic from the link.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Arpeggios at Grade 4
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio: the keys from steps 1 and 2, at Grade 4 (crotchet 80). Pick each key in the drill.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Dominant seventh arpeggios
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio, dominant 7th: G7, C7, D7, F7, hands separately, crotchet 72.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Broken chords through inversions
steps.setup: Scales, broken chords, major and minor, 6 keys, Grade 4 arpeggio speed.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Legato pedal
steps.setup: Pedal: I-vi-IV-V and I-V-vi-IV in 3 keys, at 60, then 72 BPM.
steps.done: 3 runs at 85% or better per progression at 72 BPM, on two days.

steps.title: Pattern 6: LH ballad arpeggio (1-5-8-10)
steps.setup: Accompaniment, pattern 6 (ballad arpeggio 1-5-8-10) under I-V-vi-IV in C, G and F. The pedal isn't scored.
steps.done: Two clean choruses of I-V-vi-IV in C, G and F at 72 BPM.
steps.feeds: Your Song, Make You Feel My Love

steps.title: Pattern 5: RH broken triad eighths
steps.setup: Accompaniment, pattern 5 (broken chord eighths) under any progression, in C and G.
steps.done: Two clean choruses at 80 BPM in 2 keys.

steps.title: Melody over accompaniment
steps.setup: Two hands, shell and line, melody louder. The drill doesn't score the balance beat by beat yet.
steps.done: Melody at least 10 velocity units above the other notes on 80% of beats.

steps.title: Grand-staff reading, Grade 3
steps.setup: Sight-reading, grand staff at Grade 3 (piano-5), keeping time.
steps.done: 80% on three days.

steps.title: Hear the bass line
steps.setup: Ear, bass lines: roots on 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 (the I-V-vi-IV family).
steps.done: 80% over a run, on two days.

steps.title: Two songs from the list
steps.setup: Song practice: import the song, learn it in Wait mode, loop the trouble spots, then play it in Performance.
steps.done: Pass 2 songs, one with pedal: 90% at 100% tempo in Performance, on two days.

shelf.title: Arabesque Op. 100 No. 2
shelf.teaches: Fast RH five-finger runs, staccato LH chords

fallback.label: IMSLP Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach

shelf.title: Le Onde
shelf.teaches: Wave-like LH and RH arpeggios, pedal, quiet dynamics

levels.test: Play two songs from this level's list, one of them with pedal. Play Grade 4 scales in 4 keys picked for you. Play pattern 6 under I-vi-IV-V in a key picked for you: two choruses with clean pedal.

levels.title: Syncopation and right-hand patterns
levels.goal: Get the driving pop right hand: 3+3+2 grouping, pushes, Alberti and rock octaves. Play Grade 4 technique in every key. Read 6/8 and an anacrusis.
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 4 in all 24 keys. Pop: 3+3+2, pushes, Alberti, rock octaves. Reading: grand staff at Grade 4, 6/8.

steps.title: All 12 majors at Grade 4
steps.setup: Scales, hands together, two octaves, at Grade 4. Pick each key in the drill, or use Keys: Round the circle.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: All 12 minors at Grade 4
steps.setup: Scales, harmonic and melodic minor, at Grade 4. Scored on harmonic minor. Open melodic from the link.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Arpeggios at Grade 4, all keys
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio, major and minor, Grade 4. Pick each key in the drill.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Chromatic hands together and contrary motion
steps.setup: Scales at Grade 4: chromatic from F sharp, hands together. Then contrary motion in any key (Hands apart: Contrary motion). The chromatic scale shows its fingering.
steps.done: 3 clean runs.

steps.title: Pattern 7: 3+3+2 grouping
steps.setup: Accompaniment, pattern 7 (3+3+2 eighths) under any loop. Work up to the recording's 131 BPM. Loop the Clocks intro itself in Song practice.
steps.done: 3 clean loops of the Clocks intro at the recording's 131 BPM.

steps.title: Pattern 8: pop syncopation (1, and-of-2, 4)
steps.setup: Accompaniment, pattern 8 (1, and-of-2, 4 in both hands) under any progression, in C and G.
steps.done: Two choruses at 90 BPM in 2 keys.

steps.title: Alberti and LH patterns
steps.setup: Two hands, Alberti and holds, in C, G and F. Warm up with Phrases, Alberti.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at 100 BPM in each key, on two days.

steps.title: Pattern 4: rock octave eighths
steps.setup: Accompaniment, pattern 4 (left-hand octave eighths) under any progression.
steps.done: Two choruses at 110 BPM.

steps.title: Cadences in every key
steps.setup: Voicings, cadences, all 12 keys.
steps.done: 60 chords at 85%, on two days.

steps.title: Reading at Grade 4: 6/8, anacrusis, accidentals
steps.setup: Reading, sight-reading Level 3 in 6/8, both clefs. Grand-staff reading at Grade 4 is step 10 of level 4.
steps.done: 80% on three days.

steps.title: Sixteenth syncopation
steps.setup: Rhythm, groove dictation: sixteenth kicks and ghost snares.
steps.done: 5 runs at 80%.

steps.title: Two songs from the list
steps.setup: Song practice: import the song, learn it in Wait mode, loop the trouble spots, then play it in Performance.
steps.done: Pass 2 songs: 90% at 100% tempo in Performance, on two days.

levels.test: Play two songs from this level's list, one of them classical. Play Grade 4 scales and arpeggios in 6 keys picked for you, 2 of them black-key keys. Play a chart with pattern 7 or 8 in a key picked for you: two choruses.

levels.title: Blues, boogie and rock piano
levels.goal: Play a 12-bar blues with a boogie left hand, a blues-scale right hand, a turnaround and an ending. Play rock eighths under a pop song. Reach your first Grade 5 speeds (four notes a click).
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 5 in 6 keys. Pop: 12-bar, boogie LH, blues scale, turnaround. Reading: Grade 4, lead sheet melody.

steps.title: Grade 5 speed in 6 keys
steps.setup: Scales: C, G, D and F major, A and E minor. Hands together, two octaves, at Grade 5 (minim 60, four notes a click).
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Blues scale and minor pentatonic
steps.setup: Scales, blues and minor pentatonic, in C, F, G and Bb. Hands together, crotchet 80, two notes a click. Scored on the blues scale. Open minor pentatonic from the link.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Hear the 12-bar
steps.setup: Jam, blues backing in C and F: say where bar 5, bar 9 and the turnaround are. Scored on Ear, chords in a key (I, IV, V).
steps.done: Follow 3 choruses without losing the form. Score 80% on the ear drill.

steps.title: Boogie bass, LH alone
steps.setup: Phrases: boogie bass and blues shuffle LH, in C. F and G aren't in Phrases yet.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at 100 BPM in each key, on two days.
steps.feeds: Hit the Road Jack, boogie shelf songs

steps.title: Swing and shuffle feel
steps.setup: Rhythm, read and tap: swing eighths and triplets.
steps.done: 5 runs at 80% or better on each.

steps.title: Boogie LH plus RH chords on 2 and 4
steps.setup: Accompaniment, boogie bass with right-hand chords on 2 and 4, through the 12-bar blues in C and F.
steps.done: Two choruses at 100 BPM in C and F.

steps.title: Blues licks over the changes
steps.setup: Comping: blue third over C7, F7 and G7. Then Phrases, C blues lick.
steps.done: 3 runs at 85% on each, on two days.

steps.title: Turnaround and ending
steps.setup: The I-I7-IV-#IVdim-I-VI7-ii-V7 turnaround and a chromatic ending, in C and F.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key.

steps.title: Rock eighths and pushes under a song
steps.setup: Accompaniment, patterns 4 and 8 over a song chart from the Songs group. Don't Stop Believin' and Viva la Vida aren't charted yet, so any song chart counts.
steps.done: Two clean choruses at the recording's tempo.

steps.title: Grand staff Grade 4
steps.setup: Sight-reading, grand staff at Grade 4 (piano-6), keeping time.
steps.done: 80% on three days.

steps.title: Jazz blues side trip
steps.setup: Jazz path: the 12-bar blues with shell voicings.
steps.done: The Jazz path's pass mark.

steps.title: Two songs from the list
steps.setup: Song practice: import the song, learn it in Wait mode, loop the trouble spots, then play it in Performance.
steps.done: Pass 2 songs, at least one blues or boogie: 90% at 100% tempo in Performance, on two days.

levels.test: Play a 12-bar boogie in C and F: two choruses each at 100 BPM, with the turnaround and an ending. Play two songs from this level's list, one blues or boogie and one classical. Play at Grade 5 speed in 3 keys picked for you.

levels.title: Ballad voicings and lead sheets
levels.goal: Play a ballad from a lead sheet: the melody on top of RH chords, a LH bass moving through inversions. Use add9, sus and slash chords. Play Grade 5 technique in every key.
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 5 in all keys. Pop: add9, sus, slash chords, melody on top. Reading: Grade 5.

steps.title: Grade 5 scales, all 24 keys
steps.setup: Scales, major and harmonic minor, hands together, two octaves, at Grade 5. Pick each key in the drill, or use Keys: Round the circle.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days, over the level.

steps.title: Grade 5 arpeggios, all keys
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio, major and minor, Grade 5 (minim 44).
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days, over the level.

steps.title: Diminished and dominant sevenths
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio: diminished 7th from B, C and C#, dominant 7th in 12 keys. Hands separately, then together.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per chord, on two days.

steps.title: Staccato and contrary chromatic
steps.setup: Scales: chromatic in contrary motion from one note (a major third apart isn't in the drill yet). Then Ab major and F minor staccato, hands separately. The staccato isn't scored.
steps.done: 3 clean runs, staccato notes under 50% of their value.

steps.title: Add9 and sus chords
steps.setup: Accompaniment, block chords on 1 and 3 over I-V-vi-IV with add9 and sus chords (Cadd9, Gsus4, Asus2, Fadd9). Root in the left hand. Play in C, G, F and D: 16 chords a run.
steps.done: 48 chords at 90%.

steps.title: Slash chords and walking bass lines
steps.setup: Voicings, Gospel, Slash chords: C, G/B, Am, Am/G, F, C/E, Dm7, G. Move the right hand as little as you can, bass in the left. Play in C, G and F. The drill is untimed, so once it's clean take it to Jam at 72 BPM.
steps.done: 2 clean runs in C, G and F at 72 BPM.

steps.title: Lead sheet, step 1: LH root, RH melody
steps.setup: Accompaniment, lead sheet with left-hand roots. Import Let It Be or If I Ain't Got You from MuseScore as MusicXML: the chord symbols come with it. Pick it as the tune. Twinkle and Ode to Joy are built in for learning the exercise.
steps.done: Let It Be or If I Ain't Got You from the lead sheet, two clean runs at 72 BPM.

steps.title: Lead sheet, step 2: melody on top of RH chords
steps.setup: Accompaniment, lead sheet with chords under the melody. On each change the right hand adds the chord below the melody note. The left hand plays the bass.
steps.done: The same tune, two clean runs, chords right on 90% of bars.

steps.title: Melody balance in a ballad
steps.setup: Song practice, Performance, with Also score set to Melody balance (needs MIDI velocity). Play a ballad from this level's list, the melody louder than the notes struck with it.
steps.done: Melody above the accompaniment on 80% of beats.

steps.title: Grand staff Grade 5: syncopation, four-part chords
steps.setup: Sight-reading, grand staff at Grade 5 (piano-7), keeping time.
steps.done: 80% on three days.

steps.title: Melody dictation
steps.setup: Ear, melody dictation, played back, at its third level (the major scale).
steps.done: 80% over a run, on two days.

steps.title: Transpose a lead sheet
steps.setup: The tune from step 8, in a second key picked for you.
steps.done: One clean run.

steps.title: Two songs from the list
steps.setup: Song practice: import the song, learn it in Wait mode, loop the trouble spots, then play it in Performance.
steps.done: Pass 2 songs: 90% at 100% tempo in Performance, on two days.

levels.title: Gospel and boogie 2
levels.goal: Put gospel harmony under a pop song: IV/I, the 4-5-1 passing chord, passing diminished, walk-ups and the amen ending. Play boogie with right-hand riffs. Reach your first Grade 6 speeds and four-octave scales.

steps.title: Grade 6 speed in 6 keys
steps.setup: Scales, hands together, at Grade 6 (minim 72), in 6 keys. Two octaves for now: four-octave spans aren't in Scales yet.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Dominant and diminished sevenths, all keys
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio, dominant 7th and diminished 7th, Grade 6 (minim 50).
steps.done: 3 clean runs per chord, on two days.

steps.title: IV/I and the 1-4-1 rock
steps.setup: Accompaniment, gospel 1-4-1 under I-V-vi-IV. Play each chord, its IV over the same bass on the and of 2, then back on 4. In C, F, G and Bb: 24 chords a run.
steps.done: 40 chords at 90%.
steps.feeds: Lean on Me, Let It Be

steps.title: 4-5-1 passing chord and walk-ups
steps.setup: Voicings, Gospel, Walk-up and the 4-5-1: I, ii7, I/3, IV, V/IV, I/3, IV, V7, I. Three keys a run (27 chords).
steps.done: 40 chords at 90% in 4 keys.

steps.title: Passing diminished
steps.setup: Voicings, Gospel, Passing diminished: I-#Idim7-ii7-V7 and IV-#IVdim7-I/5-V7-I. Three keys a run.
steps.done: 40 chords at 90%.

steps.title: Amen ending and the 7-3-6-2-5-1 turnaround
steps.setup: Both in C and F.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key.

steps.title: Boogie with RH riffs
steps.setup: Accompaniment, boogie bass with chords on 2 and 4 through the blues in F and G. Take the right-hand riffs from Pinetop's Boogie Woogie, looped in Song practice. The drill scores the bass and the chords.
steps.done: 3 clean loops at 120 BPM.
steps.feeds: Pinetop's Boogie Woogie, Great Balls of Fire

steps.title: Rock and roll RH triplets and glissando
steps.setup: Repeated-chord triplets over a boogie LH.

steps.title: Pattern 13: stride-lite
steps.setup: Accompaniment, pattern 13 (stride-lite, left hand only) over I-vi-ii-V and I-IV-V.

levels.title: Full arrangements, intros and fills
levels.goal: Play full piano-solo arrangements of pop songs at the recording's tempo. Take famous intros by ear. Add fills between phrases. Play Grade 6 technique in every key.
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 6 in all keys, 4 octaves. Pop: intros by ear, fills, octaves. Reading: Grade 6.

steps.title: Grade 6 scales, all keys
steps.setup: Scales, major and harmonic minor, at Grade 6, legato. Four octaves and staccato aren't in Scales yet.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key over the level, on two days each.

steps.title: Grade 6 arpeggios, all keys
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio, major and minor, at Grade 6 (minim 50). Four octaves aren't in Scales yet.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key over the level, on two days each.

steps.title: Octaves
steps.setup: Scales, Octaves: C, G and F, one hand at a time or both, two notes a click at crotchet 80. Play them staccato. Note length isn't scored.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at crotchet 80, two notes a click.
steps.feeds: Bohemian Rhapsody, Don't Stop Me Now

steps.title: Intros by ear
steps.setup: Ear, phrases from your saved songs, played back. Take the 4-bar intros of Your Song, Piano Man, Someone Like You and Clocks. Then compare in Song practice.
steps.done: Each intro played back at 90% before you open the notation.

steps.title: Fills at phrase ends
steps.setup: Pentatonic run down, grace-note slide, octave pickup, in C, F and G.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per riff in 3 keys.
steps.feeds: Bennie and the Jets, Just the Way You Are

steps.title: Syncopated pedal in a full arrangement
steps.setup: Pedal: I-V-vi-IV at 50 BPM in 3 keys. Then the pedal of a ballad from this level's list, in Song practice.
steps.done: 3 runs at 90%, on two days.

steps.title: Melody balance in a full arrangement
steps.setup: Song practice, Performance, with Also score set to Melody balance (needs MIDI velocity). Use the song you're learning from this level's list.
steps.done: Melody above the accompaniment on 85% of beats.

steps.title: Grand staff Grade 6: triplets, pedal marks, clef changes, 5/4 and 9/8
steps.setup: Sight-reading, grand staff at Grade 6 (piano-8), keeping time. Triplets and clef changes aren't in the drill yet.
steps.done: 80% on three days.

steps.title: No-stop run
steps.setup: A song from this level's list in Performance, scored for continuity.
steps.done: One full run with continuity 100% and no slip longer than a beat.

steps.title: Transcribe a 4-bar riff
steps.setup: Ear path: take a riff of your choice by ear and play it back. Then check it against the notation in Song practice.
steps.done: The riff played at 90% by ear.

steps.title: Three songs from the list
steps.setup: Song practice: import the song, learn it in Wait mode, loop the trouble spots, then play it in Performance.
steps.done: Pass 3 songs, one classical: 90% at 100% tempo in Performance, on two days.

shelf.title: Bohemian Rhapsody, piano solo
shelf.teaches: Ballad, opera section, rock section: form and octaves

shelf.title: Just the Way You Are
shelf.teaches: maj7 and add9 voicings, bossa-pop LH

shelf.title: Clocks, full
shelf.teaches: 3+3+2 at tempo with LH octaves and voicing changes

shelf.title: Moonlight Sonata, mvt 1
shelf.teaches: Triplet balance, melody over arpeggio, pedal

shelf.title: Waltz in B minor Op. 69 No. 2
Invention No. 13 in A minor, BWV 784
Rêverie
shelf.teaches: Colour, pedal, melody over syncopated LH

shelf.title: Sonata K. 545, mvt 1
shelf.teaches: Alberti at tempo, scales, classical clarity

levels.test: Play three songs from this level's list, one of them classical: 90% at 100% tempo. Play one of the three as a No-stop run. Play back one intro by ear before you see its notation. Play Grade 6 scales and arpeggios in 6 keys picked for you.

levels.title: Ragtime, rock piano and the big ballad
levels.goal: Play a stride and ragtime left hand and a Chopin nocturne. Play rock piano in the style of Billy Joel and Guns N' Roses. Make your own arrangement from a chart. Reach Grade 7 speed in 6 keys.
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 7 in 6 keys, a third apart. Pop: stride LH, Billy Joel rock piano, your own arrangement. Reading: Grade 6.

steps.title: Grade 7 speed in 6 keys
steps.setup: Scales, hands together, at Grade 7 (minim 80), in 6 keys. Two octaves for now: four-octave spans aren't in Scales yet.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Scales a third apart
steps.setup: Scales, Hands apart: A third apart, in C, G, D and F, two octaves. Grade 7 asks for four, but the drill goes to two.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key.

steps.title: First-inversion arpeggios
steps.setup: Scales, Arpeggio, Start on the 3rd: C, G and F major and A minor. Hands together, minim 56 (four notes a click).
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key at minim 56.

steps.title: Stride LH: bass and chord, octave and tenth
steps.setup: Accompaniment, stride (the root in octaves on 1, a tenth on 3, the chord on 2 and 4) over I-vi-ii-V. The Maple Leaf Rag A strain isn't charted yet.
steps.done: 3 clean runs at 80 BPM.

steps.title: Ragtime A strain
steps.setup: Song practice, Performance: Maple Leaf Rag, bars 1 to 16, looped.
steps.done: 3 clean loops at crotchet 80.

steps.title: Rock piano RH fills in 3/4 and 4/4
steps.setup: Piano Man-style turns, November Rain-style octave runs.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per riff in 2 keys.

steps.title: Own arrangement from a chart
steps.setup: Accompaniment, Lead sheet. Import a song from this level's list with its chord symbols and play the chords in the left hand. Then record it with 3 patterns, an intro and an ending. Woodshed scores the melody and the chords, not the patterns or the form.
steps.done: One take with chords right on 95% of bars.

steps.title: Grand staff Grade 6
steps.setup: Sight-reading, grand staff at Grade 6 (piano-8), keeping time.
steps.done: 80% on three days.

steps.title: Secondary dominants by ear
steps.setup: Ear, progression dictation in sevenths. Secondary dominants come from the Theory path.
steps.done: 80% over a run, on two days.

steps.title: Three songs from the list
steps.setup: Song practice: import the song, learn it in Wait mode, loop the trouble spots, then play it in Performance.
steps.done: Pass 3 songs, one classical: 90% at 100% tempo in Performance, on two days.

shelf.title: November Rain
shelf.teaches: Power ballad, octave runs, orchestral voicing

shelf.title: To Zanarkand
shelf.teaches: Lyrical game ballad, LH arpeggios, voicing

shelf.title: Raindrop Prelude Op. 28 No. 15
shelf.teaches: Repeated-note pedal point, voicing, dynamic build

shelf.title: Pathétique Sonata, mvt 2
shelf.teaches: Singing melody over inner semiquavers, three layers

shelf.title: Arabesque No. 1
shelf.teaches: Triplets against duplets, flowing arpeggios across hands

levels.test: Play three songs from this level's list, one classical and one ragtime or rock: 90% at 100% tempo. Record your own arrangement. Play Grade 7 scales in 4 keys and scales a third apart in 2 keys.

levels.title: Concert pieces and jazz-pop
levels.goal: Play Grade 7 pieces: a Bach prelude and fugue, a Chopin waltz, a Schubert impromptu. Play jazz-pop piano: Billy Joel, a gospel ballad, Ray Charles. Play Grade 7 technique in every key. Transpose a whole song.
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 7 in all keys, legato thirds. Pop: gospel runs, jazz-pop voicings, transposing a song. Reading: Grade 7.

steps.title: Grade 7 scales, all keys
steps.setup: Scales, major and harmonic minor, at Grade 7 (minim 80). Four octaves and staccato aren't in Scales yet.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key over the level.

steps.title: Grade 7 arpeggios, all keys
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio, major and minor, at Grade 7 (minim 56). For first inversions, pick Start on the 3rd.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key over the level.

steps.title: Legato thirds
steps.setup: Scales, Double thirds: G major, each hand alone, minim 46. Legato is up to you: note lengths aren't scored. The drill shows no fingering for thirds.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per hand.

steps.title: Gospel runs and pentatonic fills
steps.setup: Descending major pentatonic with grace notes, the 6-5-3 gospel run, octave tremolo, in C, F, Bb and Eb.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per riff in 2 keys.

steps.title: Jazz-pop voicings
steps.setup: Jazz path: rootless ii-V-I in Voicings, major and minor, in C, F, Bb and Eb.
steps.done: The Jazz path's pass mark (85%) in those 4 keys.
steps.feeds: New York State of Mind, Georgia

steps.title: Transpose a whole song
steps.setup: A song you passed in level 5 or 6, from its lead sheet, a tone away.
steps.done: One clean run, chords right on 95% of bars.

steps.title: Grand staff Grade 7: 7/8, 8va, tempo changes
steps.setup: Sight-reading, Piano 9 (about ABRSM Grade 7). It adds 7/8 and 5/8, five sharps or flats, triplets and the left hand in the treble clef. 8va and tempo changes aren't in the drill yet.
steps.done: 80% on three days.

steps.title: Play from memory
steps.setup: Song practice, Performance, with the notation hidden.
steps.done: One passed song from this level's list at 90% from memory.

steps.title: Fugue voices
steps.setup: Song practice, Fugue in C minor. Loop it voice by voice: the subject in each entry, then two voices, then three. Then play the full piece in Performance. Woodshed can't tell the pairings apart, so it counts clean Performance runs at half tempo or faster.
steps.done: Each pairing 3 clean loops at half tempo, then the full piece.

steps.title: Three songs from the list
steps.setup: Song practice: import the song, learn it in Wait mode, loop the trouble spots, then play it in Performance.
steps.done: Pass 3 songs, one classical and one jazz-pop: 90% at 100% tempo in Performance, on two days.

shelf.teaches: Music-hall piano, wide LH, key changes

shelf.teaches: Three moods, fast più mosso RH, rubato

shelf.title: Prelude and Fugue in C minor BWV 847
Impromptu Op. 142 No. 2
shelf.teaches: Chordal sarabande, voicing, trio in triplets

levels.test: Play three songs from this level's list, one Grade 7 classical and one jazz-pop: 90% at 100% tempo. Play one of them from memory. Transpose one passed song from its lead sheet. Play Grade 7 scales and arpeggios in 6 keys picked for you.

levels.title: Capstone: recital and a Grade 8 stretch
levels.goal: Play a 20-minute recital: five pieces in order without stopping. Make your own arrangement from a lead sheet. Learn one Grade 8 stretch piece. Read a Grade 5 piece and a pop chart at first sight. This finishes the path.
levels.adds: Scales: Grade 8 speed in 4 keys. Pop: your own arrangement, performance. Reading: Grade 5 at first sight.

steps.title: Grade 8 speed stretch
steps.setup: Scales at Grade 8 (minim 88) in 4 keys, then the whole-tone scale from C and Db. For scales a sixth apart, pick Hands apart: A sixth apart.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per item, on two days.

steps.title: Maintenance rotation
steps.setup: Scales, Keys: Round the circle, at Grade 7 speed. Each clean Check run moves on a fifth. Play four keys a day, then the harmonic minors the same way.
steps.done: One full week with every key clean.

steps.title: Recital programme chosen
steps.setup: Pick 5 passed songs: 2 classical (Grade 6 to 7), 3 pop or film, at least one from this level's list.
steps.done: The list written in the journal.

steps.title: Programme run-throughs
steps.setup: Song practice, Performance: the 5 pieces in order, scored for continuity.
steps.done: Three run-throughs on three days, each piece at 90% and continuity 100%.

steps.title: Own arrangement
steps.setup: Pick a lead sheet from the list below. Arrange it: intro, a verse with one pattern, a chorus with another, a gospel or boogie bridge, an ending. Record it. Accompaniment, Lead sheet, scores the melody and chords of imported notation with chord symbols, not the patterns or the form.
steps.done: One recorded take, chords right on 95% of bars.

links.label: Someone Like You in A, DecPlay
Bridge Over Troubled Water, Dick Schmitt
Georgia on My Mind, James T. Bartlett
Can't Help Falling in Love in C, DecPlay

steps.title: Sight-reading at first sight
steps.setup: Sight-reading, grand staff at Grade 5 (piano-7), keeping time. Use the 30 second look before each piece.
steps.done: 80% on three unseen pieces.

steps.title: Chord chart at first sight
steps.setup: Accompaniment in Check: a progression and key you haven't played, with a pattern of your choice. Woodshed doesn't pick the key for you yet.
steps.done: Chords right on 95% of bars, no stop.

steps.title: A song by ear
steps.setup: Ear path: work out the melody and chords of a song of your choice without notation. Play it in 2 keys.
steps.done: Played through, then checked against the notation.

steps.title: Record the recital
steps.setup: Record: the full programme in one take. Listen back, note 3 fixes, then record it again a week later.
steps.done: The second recording made.

shelf.teaches: Grade 8 stretch: voicing, pedal, rubato, arpeggiated climax

shelf.title: New York State of Mind, full
shelf.teaches: The recording's piano part: blues fills, jazz-pop voicings

shelf.title: Vienna
shelf.teaches: Accompaniment with moving inner voices, accordion-like RH

shelf.title: Skyfall
shelf.teaches: Orchestral ballad on piano, octaves, minor colour

shelf.title: Oh Happy Day
shelf.teaches: Gospel arrangement from a piano-vocal score: build the solo part

shelf.title: No One
shelf.teaches: I-V-vi-IV gospel-pop, build your own solo version

levels.test: Record the recital: five pieces in order. Play each at 90% or better at 100% tempo, with continuity 100%. Two of them are classical at Grade 6 to 7, and one is your own arrangement. Then play Grade 7 scales and arpeggios in 6 keys picked for you. Sight-read a Grade 5 piece at 80%.
